Hi Elena / Samir — glad to meet your timing. We've drafted the one-page scope statement and uploaded supporting artifacts to the Drive folder. High-level points:

- Evidence storage: primary intake is a pre-authorized Google Drive folder for reviewer convenience. For customers requiring signed S3 exports we provide time-limited, access-controlled bundles.
- KMS proof: we provide a redacted audit log snippet (timestamp ranges + operation types), key metadata export (key id, creation date, algorithm, rotation cadence), and a signer certificate chain. Sensitive secrets are redacted per our redaction policy.
- Telemetry: production telemetry is pseudonymized at ingest (device/user identifiers hashed with per-customer salt) and aggregated. We retain raw traces for 90 days; approved audit samples (redacted) can be staged for up to 12 months per contractual agreement.

We're attaching the scope statement and a proposed mutual action plan. Can you confirm which reviewers should receive Drive access (read-only) and whether a NDA redaction exception is required for the signer cert chain?

Best,
Kimberly Park
